crew.overview: Long ago, in the fantasy world of Kumandra, humans and dragons lived together in harmony. But when an evil force threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity. Now, 500 years later, that same evil has returned and it’s up to a lone warrior, Raya, to track down the legendary last dragon to restore the fractured land and its divided people.
crew.title: Raya and the Last Dragon

crew.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
crew.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

details.biography:
Jeff King is an American re-recording mixer based at Skywalker Sound whose credits span major feature films, documentaries, and television projects. He has contributed as re-recording mixer or assistant on notable titles including Avengers: Endgame, Black Panther, Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, Thor: Love and Thunder, Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery, Murder Mystery 2, Rather, Jazz Fest: A New Orleans Story, The Bee Gees: How Can You Mend a Broken Heart, Eternals, Encanto, Licorice Pizza, Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, various Star Wars animated series (The Bad Batch, Visions, What If…?), Lego Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy, and A Murder at the End of the World.

King’s involvement with The Bee Gees: How Can You Mend a Broken Heart (a 2020 HBO documentary) brought him significant recognition, as he served as a re-recording mixer alongside Gary A. Rizzo. That work earned them the Cinema Audio Society Award for Outstanding Achievement in Sound Mixing for a Motion Picture – Documentary in 2021. Additionally, he was among several Skywalker Sound mixers—including Brandon Proctor, Steve Boeddeker, Scott Curtis, Michael Semanick, Nathan Nance, Chris Scarabosio, Juan Peralta, and Gary Rizzo—who were nominated for a Cinema Audio Society Award for Outstanding Sound Mixing for a Motion Picture in 2019.
details.name: Jeff King
